verdict.rationale: Reducto offers an enterprise on-prem/VPC deployment option where 'all data and storage reside in the customer's VPC' (reducto-docs-15), which effectively lets enterprise customers control where their data resides. However, there is no evidence of explicit region/residency selection (e.g., US/EU data center choice) for the standard hosted API tiers, and residency control appears gated behind Enterprise deployment rather than being a general user-facing setting. Missing for 10: documented region-selection options for standard/Growth tiers, list of supported regions, and independent confirmation of VPC deployment working as described.
